mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Harriet Park and a waning crescent moon phase. The temperature is 49 degrees, and we anticipate an overnight low of 46 degrees with rain in the forecast.

City officials are busy with asphalt repairs scheduled for November 9 and 10 on North Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Also, the Public Works Department encourages residents to subscribe to the City of Verona digital newsletter to stay informed on local projects and programs.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, all taking place today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
On October 25, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in the arrest of a 40-year-old man for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently open and will be serving customers until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
